# Provider contract fixtures

These are **synthetic, representative fixtures**, not recordings of live API
responses or evidence of current provider availability. Names, IDs, and descriptions
are illustrative. Each JSON file has a normal response, partial response, and
malformed envelopes/items; the Swedish HTML uses structured Audiobook data.
No credentials or real user library information are stored here. Add redacted
live regressions when available, with provider, capture date, and expected behavior.
